name: radius
description: Radius — Discover. Connect. Participate. A location-aware community event platform on Google Cloud.

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd .. && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api:local" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:cloud: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
